paite: Mihai in alungtang in, Pathian a-om kei, achi nak hi. Ase khin ua, thil thulim lou kihhuaitak ahih uh; kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh.
heading: David La / Mite Gitlouhna / (Sam 14)
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong himhim a-om uhiam chih thei ding in Pathian in van a kipan mihing tate a-ensuk a.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

paite: Alehngat chiat ua; nintak in ana om vekta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei uh.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

paite: Thil hihkhialte'n theih anei kei ua hia! Tanghou nek bang in ka mite ane khin ua, Pathian lah asam kei uhi.
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

paite: Launa omlouhna ah alau petpet ua, Pathian in nang hon umpa guhte adalhsak ziak in; Pathian in amau amuhsit ziak in, amau na zahlaksak.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

paite: Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawtleh aw! Pathian in ami saltangte a pikik nawn chiang in, huai hun chiang in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipak ding uhi.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
